text_block_list.text:
On the day of the Arima Kinen press 
conference, the rivals she had run 
alongside up until now were gathered 
there.

Having received the Marvelous spark, her 
rivals sprinted forward along their 
respective paths.

All of them, radiating an even more 
dazzling Marvelous energy, gather at 
Nakayama as the year draws to a close.

The final key to the 'World 
Marvelous-ification Plan' that will 
envelop the whole world. The Arima Kinen 
against her rivals begins.
